checks.name: the read against the builder at off-knot points across the readable range, in the evaluator's frame (the worst of five runs)
checks.tolerance: at most 1e-2 of a block's largest component

checks.name: divergence of the read (a fourth-order stencil; the worst of five runs)
Bohlin's axial coefficient on the axis knot
the transverse coefficient on the axis, along x and along y
checks.tolerance: 1.804360 within 1e-5, x equal to y within 1e-6

checks.name: a method of fundamental solutions against the table (consistent, not a bound: its own wall residual is 3.8%)

notes: Built for MIME-ANO-117 from the defect-free Fourier-Bessel series of the unit tube's image system; it reads no other asset.

The table was built at d8bf0a6, the commit its provenance arrays name (in no branch's history), by a variant of full.py kept outside the repository that scaled every truncation factor by 1.5 through an environment variable. The commit recorded here is on v0.3 and holds the same build: the committed spec (grid G1, one truncation for every source radius, factor 1.5) read by full.py, whose 102 jobs equal the variant's entry for entry, with the spec held equal to this file's arrays by tests/oracles/test_tube_provenance.py. Three source radii rebuilt from it on Modal agree with the shipped blocks to 1e-15 relative (bitwise on the axis, not elsewhere): the inputs are reproduced, the bytes are not claimed to be. 'dirty' is not recorded: the shipped file was not built from this commit's tree.

The checks are the gate's of 2026-10-29, at tolerances declared before the table existed, each with the defective series on the same grid as its control (it fails each); MIME-ANO-117 states them with their controls. The read's measured maximum against the builder over its dense lines is 0.23% (on the first table; the grid is the same).
